title: Evaluation under coordinate permutation
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinates, let $T$ be a finite-alphabet decision tree on all $n$ coordinates with labels in $\alpha$, and let $x$ assign an alphabet symbol to each coordinate. Evaluating the tree obtained by permuting the coordinates of $T$ by $\sigma$ at $x$ equals evaluating $T$ at the input $i\mapsto x(\sigma(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: A permutation σ of Fin n
A finite-alphabet decision tree on all n coordinates with labels in α
An input x : Fin n → Ω
